name: 2R-CH
description: 2R-CH, also known as Torch, was a battle droid equipped with a flamethrower who worked with the Advozse Hegemony during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Around 3643 BBY, 2R-CH occupied Hammer Station with other Hegemony forces and was eventually destroyed by a strike team that proceeded to destroy the space station.
